class.name: DSProfiler
class.brief_description: Performance profiling and NVMe transfer throughput monitor for DirectStorage.
class.description: [DSProfiler] tracks read workload durations and bytes transferred. The extension registers it as the [Engine] singleton named [code]"DSProfiler"[/code]. [method register_performance_monitors] adds [code]"directstorage/throughput_mbps"[/code] to Godot's [Performance] monitors.

method.name: get_last_bytes
method.description: Returns the total bytes read in the last profiled workload.

method.name: get_last_duration_us
method.description: Returns the microsecond duration of the last profiled workload.

method.name: get_last_throughput_mbps
method.description: Returns the calculated transfer throughput in megabytes per second (MB/s).

method.name: record_workload
method.description: Records a completed read workload with the total [param bytes] and elapsed duration [param duration_us].

method.name: register_performance_monitors
method.description: Registers custom Performance monitors with Godot Engine's debugger system.
